task.news: Nela spent weeks recording a local radio programme. A damaged drive destroyed the only copy just before its first broadcast.

task.user: Nela spent weeks recording a local radio programme. A damaged drive destroyed the only copy just before its first broadcast. Respond to this update and suggest one practical next step. Use two sentences.

response: That's incredibly frustrating—losing the only copy of such an important project just before its debut must feel overwhelming. A practical next step would be to check if any backup files were saved in the cloud or on another device, even if they're incomplete.
